findings.description: The new protocol line tells workers to pipe test runs to `tail` or `grep` and says `set -o pipefail` keeps the exit status, 75 included. That is wrong for `grep`. Under pipefail, bash and zsh return the status of the rightmost command that failed, and `grep` exits 1 when nothing matches. When the test slots stay busy, `runSessionTest` writes only to stderr (src/core/test-slot.service.ts:560-564), so `grep` gets empty input and the pipeline returns 1 instead of 75. A passing run piped to a failure filter such as `grep -E 'FAIL|Error'` also returns 1, so green tests look red.
findings.body:
**The `grep` half of the new rule loses the exit status it says it keeps.**

The line says that piping a test run to `tail` or `grep` after `set -o pipefail` keeps the exit status, 75 included. With pipefail, bash and zsh return the status of the *rightmost* command that exited non-zero, and `grep` exits 1 whenever nothing matches:

- **Slots busy:** when no slot frees up, `runSessionTest` prints only to stderr ([test-slot.service.ts#L558-L564](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/fd2cea5bd3df0d4c91fd9f302f64d6baaab32a46/src/core/test-slot.service.ts#L558-L564)). The wait messages go to stderr too (`onWait` uses `console.error`), and the test child is never started. So in `set -o pipefail; pup session test a.test.ts | grep -E 'FAIL|Tests'`, `grep` reads empty input and exits 1, and the pipeline returns **1, not 75**. The protocol line just above ([L579-L580](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/fd2cea5bd3df0d4c91fd9f302f64d6baaab32a46/src/core/profile-compiler.service.ts#L579-L580)) tells the worker that 75 means "retry, not a test failure". Exit 1 tells it the opposite.
- **Green run:** `pup session test a.test.ts | grep -E 'FAIL|Error'` finds no match when the tests pass, so the pipeline returns 1 and a passing run looks like a failure.

`tail` is safe because it exits 0 on any input, so 75 and test failures both come through. Only `grep` breaks the promise ([profile-compiler.service.ts#L589-L593](https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/fd2cea5bd3df0d4c91fd9f302f64d6baaab32a46/src/core/profile-compiler.service.ts#L589-L593)).

Fix: recommend only `tail` for test runs, or warn that `grep` exits 1 on no match. Update the sentence that `src/core/profile-compiler-context.test.ts` pins and the matching claim in `docs/adr/0189-…` in the same change.

findings.description: The ADR cites "the context budget (decisions 71 and 128)", but 71 is about parser typing of `contextBudget` and 128 about kickoff scope-in files; neither sets the budget, so a reader following the citation lands on unrelated decisions.
The module doc still says `pup session ask` echoes the numbered question, which this PR stopped; only `pup conductor ask` echoes it now.
The `// Decision 189:` comment restates the "every result is re-read on each later request" reason that the string right below it already says; keep the decision pointer and drop the repeated reason.

It adds no new input handling or shell-out. Also skipped simplicity (only new file is an ADR), context, spec (no closing issue), workflow-safety and maintainability (gates not met).
